messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: high 5xx rate for /v1/generate on inference-prod. Trigger: 5m error rate > 5% (automated). Sev: P1. Paging @alex (oncall). Alert: https://ops.redwood/alerts/12345

alex: On it — looking at Grafana + traces now. Starting with last 30m.

jamie: I can tail the pods, adding myself. Running:
```bash
kubectl logs -n prod deployment/inference -c model --tail 200 -l app=inference\```

alex: Traces show a burst of upstream 503s from a subset of pods. Not a full cluster failure. Trying scaling and toggle fallback model to reduce errors.

sato: Scaling up replicas now to absorb the spike.
```bash
kubectl scale deployment inference -n prod --replicas=30\```
Also going to temporarily relax HPA target to avoid thrashing. Will revert after RCA. :wrench:

maria: Support note — early look shows ~12 customers experienced errors (mostly short-lived). Engaging account teams for affected customers: Acme, NovaPay, BrightHR. Drafting comms.

alex: Mitigation: scaled + enabled fallback -> error rate dropping to baseline. Rolling 5xxs reduced. Marking incident as mitigated. Handoff to @jamie for RCA and postmortem follow-up. :white_check_mark:

jamie: I'll own the RCA + postmortem. Scheduling a 1h sync for tomorrow 11:00 PT to go over timeline and proposed fixes. Creating postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/incident-12345 (please add notes).

pm-erin: For the postmortem please create action items with: owner, size (S/M/L), priority (P1/P2), and whether it ties into quarterly planning. If any infra work required mark as Q3 infra backlog or flag for Q2 if urgent.

jamie: Drafting action items now — initial list (will create tickets):
1) Autoscaler thresholds too aggressive -> adjust HPA metrics and add safety bounds. Owner: sato. Size: M. Priority: P1. Quarter: Q3 infra (unless we need emergency change).
2) Add synthetic traffic test for model cache/invalidations to catch regressed cache behavior. Owner: ops-sre. Size: S. Priority: P1. Quarter: Q2 ops (can be quick).
3) Improve fallback model routing to avoid 503 waterfall when KV cache misses spike. Owner: alex. Size: L. Priority: P2. Quarter: Q4 product roadmap or expedited if customers require.
4) Customer impact reconciliation + SLA review + comms follow-ups. Owner: maria. Size: S. Priority: P1. Quarter: immediate (support ops).

alex: Add monitor tuning: reduce noisy alerting, add a rolling-5m low-latency synthetic check for /v1/generate. Owner: ops-sre. Size: S. Priority: P2. Ticketing: RED-456.

jamie: Creating tracker issues now: RED-456 (synthetics), RED-457 (HPA thresholds), RED-458 (fallback routing). Linking to postmortem doc and quarterly board: https://tracker.redwood/board/infra-q3.

maria: I'll push the customer comms draft to the postmortem doc and ping account teams for any requested credits.

ops-sre: Will scope the synthetic test, ETA 3 business days. Will include a runbook for oncall to validate cache health quickly.

jamie: OK — since some items are infra-impacting, tagging sato & ops-sre as owners and recommending we keep the HPA change behind a canary rollout. Action item owners, please add time estimates to the tracker tickets (hours/days).

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 1778004430. Root cause: HPA thrash + cache invalidation cascade causing transient 503s. Postmortem owner: jamie. Severity: P1.

alex: We should also add a quarter-tie tag on each ticket (e.g., "q3-infra" or "q2-ops") so PM planning picks it up.

pm-erin: I'll triage which items go into the Q2 planning meeting vs the product backlog. If sato needs prioritization help, ping me.

jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll finalize the postmortem doc, attach the timelines, and create the action items in the tracker by EOD. Moving thread to follow-up; please continue to add comments in the doc.

maria: Closing loop with affected customers today and will report back in the doc.

alex: Leaving a short remediation note on the deployment: `reverted hpa aggressive policy -> added minReplicas` and will follow up in the ticket.

incident-bot: Thread closed (incident resolved). Summary and links in postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/incident-12345.
